title: Cycle Legal Check independently labeled 100-route evaluation
purpose: Measures whether the production analyzer flags explicit mapped prohibitions on 100 stored route segments. It does not measure legal accuracy, map completeness, temporary restrictions, or whether a route is lawful.

provenance.retrieval: Overpass API `out tags geom`; static snapshots retained below so tests make no network request.
provenance.label_policy: A route is positive only when its stored source way has an explicit `bicycle=no|private` or `speed_pedelec=no|private` tag applicable to the selected vehicle. Those contributor-supplied tags are the independent labels.
provenance.selection_policy: First 34 Belgium speed-pedelec, 33 Netherlands bicycle-access, and 33 Berlin bicycle-access ways returned by the recorded bounded queries. Netherlands and Germany cases alternate bicycle and 25 km/h e-bike profiles.
provenance.audit_note: Every route has a unique OSM way URL, stored tag evidence, vehicle, region, and source geometry. Expected rule IDs are assigned from the published label policy, not copied from analyzer results.
